changelog: v40 makes the owner-facing alert email flow clear and gives every register press a visible result. Units updating from v36-v39 get this together with the v37-v39 feature set they never saw (alert emails identify the reporting unit by its id, e.g. 'cytech-34', in subject and body; the unit's OWNER registers their alert email themselves via Config Files > System Health ('Register with Cytech'); a device-local generated smtp notify platform; template-button register action). What v40 changes: (1) the owner's field is renamed 'My Email' -- the address is the OWNER's, not Cytech's, and the old name read the other way around. (2) Pressing Register with the field empty now shows a clear status 'Enter your email first, then press Register.' and sends NOTHING (previously it silently rejected: no mail, no visible status -- owners and support both read that as a broken button). (3) A successful Register now sends ONE mail To: the owner, Cc: support@cytech.biz ('Cytech alert email confirmation: <unit>') -- the owner immediately sees a confirmation in their own inbox, and Cytech still receives the registration notice (unit id + owner address) for the unit<->owner registry; a wrong address fails at send time with an explicit error status instead of being stored silently. (4) EVERY Register press now shows a screen popup ('Cytech alert email' persistent notification) with the status message, in addition to the inline line under the button. (5) Units with mail configured but no owner registered yet show a small, non-blocking hint at the bottom of System Health: 'Alert emails are not set up for this system yet -- enter your email in the My Email field and press Register with Cytech.' Nothing is lost if the owner never registers: every alert still goes automatically to support@cytech.biz (that always-generated platform exists on every unit); only the owner's own copy is missing.
